headline: Co-op shares campaign progress as Going Commando passes 7,100 matched functions
summary: Multiplayer now shares items, gold bolts and planets, improves bolt pickups and smooths remote movement, with v0.7.3 bringing Android builds. OpenRAC's develop branch fixes Drone Device spawns and Novalis sparks, simplifies level editing and adds enhanced environment reflections. Custom ship destinations landed with PAL-only support and manual gameplay testing still outstanding. Going Commando's USA v1.01 progress reaches 7,100 of 8,578 functions and 65.83% matched code by size after rac2-decomp#368's 842-function import, where matching means compiling to exactly the original game's bytes. Deadlocked gains PAL and shared-code batches, Up Your Arsenal gains NTSC-U frontend routines, and launcher v0.10.0 remains a release proposal with no change to master today.
